title: Resolvent Estimates for the Stokes Operator in a Three-Dimensional Lipschitz Domain
summary: By refining the approach developed in \cite{AGH-2015, GS2026a}, we establish resolvent estimates in $L^p_σ(Ω)$ for the Stokes operator in a bounded Lipschitz domain $Ω$ in $\R^3$ for any $(3/2)-\e 0$ depends on $Ω$. As a consequence, the Stokes operator generates a uniformly bounded analytic semigroup in $L^p_σ(Ω)$. The results are particularly surprising, as it is long believed that the $L^p$ resolvent estimates in three-dimensional Lipschitz domains may fail for large $p$.
